{{Quote|Observing the world around them, they saw two moons in the one sky&mdash;light Ashla and dark Bogan&mdash;and they understood the dual aspects to the Force, light and dark.|[[Ketu]], on Tythans|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Ashla''' was one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. Observing both Ashla and [[Bogan]], the other natural [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]], the [[Tythan|first settlers]] of Tython recognized the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] aspects of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Later, both moons were colonized by non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Tythans who built stone [[City/Legends|cities]] there and subsequently settled [[Settled Worlds|the rest]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. During the [[Battle of Tython|final battle]] of the [[Despot War]]&mdash;a conflict waged by [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]] of the planet of [[Shikaakwa]] against the mystic [[Je'daii Order]]&mdash;many Shikaakwan [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] crashed [[Pho-V fighter|their starfighters]] on Ashla, with the remains of the [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]] being salvaged by the Je'daii after the war.

By [[25,793 BBY]], Ashla had been abandoned by the original settlers and was used as a place of [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] by the Je'daii Order for its members who had veered too much to the light side of the Force. Those Je'daii would contemplate the darkness of the moon of Bogan, while the Je'daii sent to Bogan for straying too far to the dark side meditated on Ashla in return. One of the Je'daii exiles on Ashla was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rori Fenn]], who spent some time on the moon and then was allowed to return to Tython.

==Description==
Along with [[Bogan]], Ashla comprised the pair of [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;the fifth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] that was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> From [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]], Ashla appeared to be mostly [[Color/Legends|light-gray]] in color, with several regions of the surface being blue-colored. The moon had an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with clouds that appeared white from [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="DotJ5">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 5|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 5]]</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|The Tythans who were not Je'daii left Tython, going first to the moons, Ashla and Bogan, and from there outward&mdash;to populate the other worlds in the system.|[[Ketu]]|<ref name="DotJ1" />}}
[[File:TythonBoganAshla-DotJ0.png|thumb|right|300px|Ashla was one of the two moons of Tython.]]
When the [[Tythan|first settlers]] of Tython observed Ashla and Bogan, they developed the notions of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;which they also called Ashla and Bogan, respectively&mdash;and understood the necessity for a balance between those two Force aspects.<ref name="DotJ1" /> These beliefs gave rise to a legend of the [[Je'daii Order]] which stated that the two moons were birthed by Tython from its fiery core in order to remind of the perpetual struggle between dark and light to all those who sought balance.<ref name="DotJ6" /> In the second [[Time/Legends|millennium]] following the [[Tho Yor Arrival|settlement]] of Tython,<ref name="DotJ1" /> the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Tythans colonized the moons, building stone [[City/Legends|cities]] there, and later settled the [[Settled Worlds|rest of the worlds]] in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]].<ref name="DotJ6" />

Millennia later, [[Hadiya]]&mdash;the [[Queen/Legends|queen]] of the planet of [[Shikaakwa]]&mdash;sent [[Despot Army|her armies]] to [[Battle of Tython|attack]] the Je'daii on Tython.<ref name="DotJ1" /> During the ensuing battle, many Shikaakwan [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] crashed their [[Pho-V fighter|''Pho-V'' fighters]] on the planet's moons. Following the end of the war, both Ashla and Bogan were scoured by the Je'daii for remains of the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].<ref name="DotJ7">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 2|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 2]]</ref> By [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="CBR">{{WebCite|url=https://www.cbr.com/nycc-exclusive-ostrander-and-duursema-unveil-star-wars-dawn-of-the-jedi|text=NYCC EXCLUSIVE: Ostrander and Duursema Unveil "Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi"|archivedate=20200817183352|date=2011-10-13|quote=[&hellip;] the series really gets going with events just prior to the Force Wars, which began in 25,793 BBY.}}</ref> Ashla had been abandoned by the settlers and was used as a place where the Je'daii would send those members of the Order who had strayed too far to the light side of the Force. Those [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] Je'daii would [[Meditation/Legends|meditate]] on the moon of Bogan in order to re-achieve balance between the two aspects of the Force, while, conversely, the Je'daii who had veered too much to the dark side were sent to Bogan and contemplated the moon of Ashla.<ref name="DotJ0" /> One of the Je'daii exiles on Ashla was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Rori Fenn]] who spent some time on the moon and was subsequently allowed to return to Tython.<ref name="DotJ7" />

==Locations==
The first settlers of Ashla built cities on the moon, using stone as a building material. The ruins of those cities were used millennia later by the Je'daii who were exiled to the moon.<ref name="DotJ6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The moon Ashla was first depicted in [[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]], a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]] and was published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="DotJ0" /> on [[February 1]], [[2012]].<ref name="Marvel 0">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54135/star_wars_dawn_of_the_jedi_2012|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi (2012)}}</ref> Ashla made its first [[in-universe]] appearance in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first issue]] of the series,<ref name="DotJ1" /> published on [[February 15]] of the same year.<ref name="Marvel 1">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54136/star_wars_dawn_of_the_jedi_-_force_storm_2012_1|text=Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi - Force Storm (2012) #1}}</ref> The Tython system, and therefore Ashla, was placed in grid square L-10 by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />

In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]], a single moon of Tython appeared in a cutscene depicting the player-controlled [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Padawan's]] approach to the planet, however the moon was not identified as either Ashla or Bogan. This cutscene was later revised (as part of an update to all class introductions and planetary approaches) to show both moons, but both are depicted as light grey in color.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
